name: Rizetto
source:
She is the daughter of a fellow hero who defeated the Demon King. Elemia is her older sister and she loves her very much. She is pure and innocent, and has never doubted anyone. She has inherited her parents' talent in magic, and is even called a genius.

[Translated from the [url=http://liquid.nexton-net.jp/darklord/character.html#chr03]official website[/url]]
